events.title: First word!
events.text: {{s.firstName}} babbles at breakfast. The whole family leans in — what will the first real word be?

effects.tpl: The word is 'mama'! Everyone cries. Happiness blooms.
You capture it on video. Years later this clip still gets played.

events.title: Sand snack
events.text: At the park, {{s.firstName}} eats a triumphant fistful of sand.

effects.tpl: Gritty. Gross. Hilarious. No harm done.
Doctor: 'Just sand.' Bill: $80. Parenthood!

events.title: Daycare incident
events.text: {{s.firstName}} bit another toddler over a toy dinosaur. The other parents are staring.

effects.tpl: A shaky apology and a shared dino. Social skills +.
You growl at a 3-year-old's mom. The room goes silent.

events.title: Little melody
events.text: {{s.firstName}} hums a perfect little melody nobody taught them.

effects.tpl: A toy piano appears. The house fills with plinks.
The melody fades like a dream.

events.title: Midnight fever
events.text: {{s.firstName}} wakes burning up at 2am, crying.

effects.tpl: Just a virus. Fluids, rest, relief. -$300.

else.tpl: It got worse — a clinic visit anyway. Health suffers.

events.title: Stray dog
events.text: A scruffy stray follows {{s.firstName}} home, tail wagging.

effects.tpl: Biscuit joins the family. Best decision ever.
Owner found, tears of joy. Karma +.

events.title: Mall meltdown
events.text: Full floor tantrum in the mall. uestion: candy. Volume: air-raid.

effects.tpl: You carry the screaming burrito out with dignity.
Silence, bought for $3. A dangerous precedent.

events.title: Magic trick gone wrong
events.text: {{s.firstName}} swallowed a coin. 'For magic,' they explain.

effects.tpl: All clear. The coin passes. The magic fizzles.

then.tpl: It passes naturally. Never speak of this.

events.title: Invisible friend
events.text: {{s.firstName}} solemnly introduces Zorp, a nine-foot invisible dragon who lives in the pantry and eats socks.

effects.tpl: You set a plate for Zorp. The stories get wilder — and wonderful.
Zorp moves away. The house feels quieter. You feel awful.

events.title: Midnight thunder
events.text: A thunderstorm rattles the windows. {{s.firstName}} appears in the doorway, blanket in hand, eyes wide.

effects.tpl: Pillow walls, flashlight shadows. The storm becomes an adventure.
Just clouds bumping! Brave nod. Still sleeps on your floor.

events.title: Lost at the fair
events.text: Chasing a butterfly, {{s.firstName}} wanders off at the fair — and suddenly the crowd is all strangers.

effects.tpl: A vendor hears, holds your hand, pages the parents. Hugs for an hour.

then.tpl: You spot the balloon stand and retrace steps. Found!

else.tpl: An hour of terror ends at the lost-kids tent. Ice cream helps. -$100.

events.title: Storm-drain ducklings
events.text: {{s.firstName}} spots five ducklings peeping from a storm drain. Mama duck paces, frantic.

effects.tpl: Soggy, saved, paraded home in a shoebox. Heroes.
Officers arrive with nets. You supervise like a general.

events.title: Orchard day
events.text: Apple picking: {{s.firstName}} eats two for every one in the bag.

effects.tpl: Sticky, happy, and the bag is somehow still full.
Twelve apples counted. Three times. Math tastes good.

events.title: Bathtub admiral
events.text: Bath time becomes a naval battle. Half the water is on the floor.

effects.tpl: You are soaked, the baby is thrilled, the floor is a lake.
Splashing is now a regulated activity. The baby appeals.

events.title: Bird breakfast
events.text: Birds gather at dawn and {{s.firstName}} wants to feed them all.

effects.tpl: A feathered festival on the lawn.
Three bird calls identified. One crow befriended.

events.title: Tower engineer
events.text: The block tower reaches nine high. It sways like a tiny skyscraper.

effects.tpl: Crash! Physics learned. Rebuild begins instantly.
Photo saved. The tower still falls, but gloriously.

events.title: Bubble hunter
events.text: A bubble wand turns the yard into a hunting ground.

effects.tpl: Popped bubbles, tired legs, perfect afternoon.
You learn bubble physics. The baby learns joy.

events.title: Escape artist
events.text: {{s.firstName}} defeats the car-seat buckle. Again.

effects.tpl: New seat, new buckles, temporary peace.
Sing-alongs keep the escapee seated. Barely.

events.title: Yard chase
events.text: {{s.firstName}} and the dog invent a game with no rules and full sprinting.

effects.tpl: You call fouls nobody understands. Everyone wins.
Hydration enforced. Second half even faster.

events.title: Cookie heist
events.text: A chair pushed to the counter. A jar lid loosened. Intent is clear.

effects.tpl: One cookie, legally obtained. The heist gene sleeps.
Two cookies, zero regrets, crumbs everywhere.

events.title: Crayon muralist
events.text: {{s.firstName}} decorates the living-room wall with a bold purple period.

effects.tpl: It is art now. Guests pretend to understand it.
Forty dollars of washable crayons later, the walls are safe.

events.title: Dandelion clock
events.text: A perfect dandelion clock. One breath. {{s.firstName}} concentrates.

effects.tpl: Seeds scatter over the yard. Wishes: pending.
Next spring: a hundred wishes bloom yellow.

events.title: Gourmet dog bowl
events.text: {{s.firstName}} has decided the dog's kibble looks delicious.

effects.tpl: Intercepted mid-crunch. Crisis averted, dog offended.
Funny for three seconds, then the talk about dog food.

events.title: Rain listener
events.text: Rain hammers the windows and {{s.firstName}} just listens, wide-eyed.

effects.tpl: Ten quiet minutes. The storm does the talking.
Boots by the door. Tomorrow: puddles.

events.title: Pot drummer
events.text: Pots plus wooden spoon equals a concert at 7am.

effects.tpl: The Pot Symphony debuts. Neighbors pretend to love it.
Muffled genius. Everyone keeps their hearing.

events.title: Duck parade
events.text: Ducks cross the path in single file and {{s.firstName}} falls in line behind them.

effects.tpl: You march behind ducks. Strangers applaud.
Torn bread, happy ducks, a delighted toddler.

events.title: Sky flowers
events.text: First fireworks: {{s.firstName}} hides, then peeks, then gasps.

effects.tpl: Best seat in town. Oohs and aahs all night.
Earmuffs work. The finale gets a standing ovation.

events.title: First steps
events.text: Everyone gathers as {{s.firstName}} wobbles upright, arms out like a tiny acrobat.

effects.tpl: Three steps, then a plop onto the rug. The room erupts.
Cookie-powered: five whole steps. Cookies work.

events.title: Wishing coin
events.text: {{s.firstName}} gets one coin for the fountain and one enormous wish.

effects.tpl: Wished for a dinosaur. The splash says maybe.
Piggy bank wins. The wish waits its turn.

events.title: Grandma's kitchen
events.text: Grandma lets {{s.firstName}} lick the spoon and eat half the dough.

effects.tpl: Sugar, laughter, and a flour-covered angel.
Three cookies survive to baking. Grandma winks at you.

events.title: Meltdown over melt
events.text: The ice cream melts faster than {{s.firstName}} can lick. Tragedy looms.

effects.tpl: Second cone, eaten at lightning speed. Lesson unlearned.
A new life skill: competitive licking.

events.title: Rhyme time
events.text: Library rhyme time: twenty babies, one guitar, total chaos.

effects.tpl: {{s.firstName}} claps off-beat with total commitment.
Ten board books home. Bedtime is now a festival.

events.title: 3am aria
events.text: {{s.firstName}} wakes screaming at 3am for the fourth night running.

effects.tpl: You rock, hum, and survive on love and coffee.
You invent a shift schedule worthy of a hospital. It works.

events.title: Moon spotter
events.text: {{s.firstName}} spots the moon from the porch and says goodnight to it.

effects.tpl: Goodnight moon, goodnight stars, goodnight porch light.
The Cheese Crater is officially discovered.

events.title: Nap strike
events.text: {{s.firstName}} refuses naps with the fury of a tiny union leader.

effects.tpl: No nap. A feral 6pm bedtime follows.
Engine hum wins. Asleep before the second stoplight.

events.title: Handprint gallery
events.text: Finger paint day: hands, feet, and one mysterious elbow print.

effects.tpl: A hallway gallery grows. Grandma cries happy tears.
Smocks on, mess contained, art still great.

events.title: Peekaboo champion
events.text: {{s.firstName}} has discovered peekaboo and demands it at every meal.

effects.tpl: Two hundred rounds of peekaboo. Your face hurts from smiling.
Now it is waving. At everyone. Including the dog.

events.title: Ant summit
events.text: Ants discover the picnic. {{s.firstName}} wants to invite them to stay.

effects.tpl: Blanket moved, ants keep the crumbs, all happy.
An hour of ant science. Picnic saved, knowledge gained.

events.title: Fort architect
events.text: Couch cushions become a fortress with one very small guard.

effects.tpl: The fort falls. Rebuilding starts before the cushions land.
One grape toll paid. Entry granted to the blanket kingdom.

events.title: Puddle monarch
events.text: Rain means one thing: every puddle must be personally tested.

effects.tpl: Soaked socks, shining eyes, zero regrets.
Proper boots. Puddles conquered safely.

events.title: Puppy ambush
events.text: A neighbor puppy bowls {{s.firstName}} over with pure love.

effects.tpl: The puppy adopts you on the spot. Biscuit Jr. stays.
A good brushing, a sad goodbye, a happy neighbor.

events.title: Sandbox diplomacy
events.text: Another toddler claims the swing, the slide, and {{s.firstName}}'s bucket.

effects.tpl: Bucket shared. A beautiful, muddy friendship begins.
Bucket recovered. The other toddler files a formal scream.

events.title: Snow taster
events.text: First snow: {{s.firstName}} catches flakes on the tongue like treasure.

effects.tpl: Cold tongues, warm mittens, white world.
A lopsided snowman guards the yard all week.

events.title: Sock theater
events.text: Lost socks become a puppet cast with dramatic ambitions.

effects.tpl: The Sock Tragedy runs one night only. Standing ovation.
Pairs reunited. The theater closes; the drawer rejoices.

events.title: Rubber duck regatta
events.text: Five rubber ducks race across the bath. {{s.firstName}} referees.

effects.tpl: Yellow wins by a beak. The crowd goes wild.
Extra bubbles. Everyone floats home happy.

events.title: Splash pad dash
events.text: The splash pad opens and {{s.firstName}} sprints straight into the jets.

effects.tpl: Shivering, giggling, and begging for one more run.
Towel cape on. Splash hero, zero sniffles.

events.title: Sprinkler sprint
events.text: The sprinkler clicks on and childhood calls.

effects.tpl: Cold, loud, perfect. Summer in one memory.
Proper gear, maximum splashing, zero regrets.

events.title: Sticker artist
events.text: {{s.firstName}} covers faces — yours, theirs, the cat's — in star stickers.

effects.tpl: You go to the store starred. Nobody mentions it. Kindness.
Paper galaxies bloom. The cat is spared.

events.title: One more story
events.text: Bedtime story ends. {{s.firstName}} whispers the ancient words: again.

effects.tpl: Third reading, with voices. Worth every minute.
Speed-run story. Asleep by the last page anyway.

events.title: Teddy ER
events.text: Teddy's arm is hanging by a thread. {{s.firstName}} demands a doctor.

effects.tpl: Three stitches, one bandage, Teddy lives. Hero status.
A toy-shop nurse sews him up. {{s.firstName}} supervises.

events.title: Tickle monster
events.text: The tickle monster has cornered {{s.firstName}} behind the couch.

effects.tpl: Squeals echo. The monster shows mercy. Eventually.
The monster gets got. Justice is giggly.

events.title: Tiny conductor
events.text: {{s.firstName}} lines up toy trains with total seriousness.

effects.tpl: On time, every time. The stuffed bear commutes daily.
A shoebox tunnel doubles capacity. Genius.

events.title: First taste of avocado
events.text: Today the baby tries avocado for the first time. The verdict: a look of pure betrayal.

effects.tpl: Suspicion turns to joy. avocado is officially approved.
Rejected with drama. Milk wins again. No shame in retreat.

events.text: Grandma arrives with knit blanket. The baby's eyes go enormous. "Just like your mother was."

effects.tpl: knit blanket works its ancient magic. Three generations on one couch.
You memorize every step of knit blanket. Traditions need couriers.

events.text: An entire bottle of bubbles, deployed at once. Cleanup supplies: deployed.

effects.tpl: Evidence preserved. Cleanup takes an hour; the picture lasts forever.
Tiny sponge, huge effort. The mess becomes the lesson.

events.title: The great mud pie factory

events.text: Naps are suddenly for other babies. Warm milk, cool room, low lights.

effects.tpl: The old songs still work. Sleep finally lands like snow.
Shifts assigned, earplugs distributed. Parenting is logistics.

events.text: The stroller rolls toward the fountain square in golden evening light. The baby narrates in vowels.

effects.tpl: the fountain square has never been this interesting. Pigeons: astonishing.
Fresh air works its magic. Two hours of stroller sleep.

events.title: Trip to the playground
events.text: The stroller rolls toward the playground past the blooming trees. The baby narrates in vowels.

effects.tpl: the playground has never been this interesting. Pigeons: astonishing.
Fresh air works its magic. Two hours of stroller sleep.
